2607.28243.title: EgoGenesis: Egocentric World-Action Modeling with Online Anchored Projective Memory and Action-3D RoPE
2607.28243.paper_summary: Egocentric video offers rich manipulation experience for embodied AI, yet collecting diverse egocentric data across scenes, objects, motions, and embodiments remains costly. We present \method, an egocentric world-action simulator that synthesizes controllable, high-quality manipulation videos to expand scarce real-world training data. \method{} builds on a pretrained video generation prior and introduces two geometry-aware conditioning mechanisms. Online Anchored Projective Memory (OAPM) preserves a first-frame 3D scene anchor while periodically refreshing a recent state during autoregressive generation. Action-3D Rotary Position Embedding (A3D-RoPE) encodes end-effector motion with camera-aware 3D rotary coordinates, injecting action geometry into skeleton-to-video cross-attention for precise control. Together, these components improve visual fidelity, geometric stability, and action alignment in long egocentric rollouts. Moreover, augmenting 400 real trajectories with 400 \method-generated trajectories improves out-of-distribution real-robot success from 77\% to 84\% on single-arm tasks and from 53\% to 70\% on dual-arm tasks, demonstrating that the synthesized data substantially improve downstream WAM generalization.
2607.28243.paper_summary_zh: 自我中心視頻為具身AI提供了豐富的操作體驗，但在場景、物體、動作和具身方面收集多樣的自我中心數據仍然成本高昂。我們提出了\method，一個自我中心世界行動模擬器，合成可控的高品質操作視頻，以擴展稀缺的真實世界訓練數據。\method{}基於預訓練的視頻生成先驗，並引入了兩種幾何感知的條件機制。線上錨定投影記憶（OAPM）在自回歸生成過程中保留第一幀的3D場景錨點，同時定期刷新最近的狀態。動作-3D旋轉位置嵌入（A3D-RoPE）使用相機感知的3D旋轉坐標編碼末端執行器的運動，將動作幾何注入骨架到視頻的交叉注意力中，以實現精確控制。這些組件共同提高了長期自我中心展開中的視覺真實性、幾何穩定性和動作對齊。此外，將400個真實軌跡與400個\method生成的軌跡進行增強，使單臂任務的分佈外真實機器人成功率從77\%提高到84\%，雙臂任務的成功率從53\%提高到70\%，證明合成數據顯著改善了下游WAM的泛化能力。
